title: Pipeline orchestration controllers have zero unit test coverage
statement: model_cache.go (904 LOC, 6 funcs), modelcache_quantization.go (709 LOC, 15 funcs), modelcache_abliteration.go (501 LOC, 7 funcs), modelcache_finetune.go (439 LOC, 5 funcs), and 8 more controller files totaling ~2,800 LOC have no corresponding test files. These are the most actively changed files and contain complex job orchestration logic.
evidence: find + wc -l analysis: 20 controller source files have no *_test.go counterpart. Top untested by LOC: model_cache.go=904, modelcache_quantization.go=709, modelcache_abliteration.go=501, modelcache_finetune.go=439, model_cache_jobs_local.go=366, runtime_controller.go=320. git hotspot analysis shows model_controller.go (66 changes), modelcache_controller.go (25), modelcache_quantization.go (16), modelcache_abliteration.go (17) as top change targets.
notes: These files manage download/quantize/abliterate/finetune job lifecycle with many edge cases (race conditions, cleanup traps, NFS slowness). Bugs in this code have required 3+ manual intervention cycles. Priority: model_cache.go and modelcache_quantization.go first — they are the most complex and most frequently changed.

title: Legacy v1alpha1 API creates maintenance drag and lint suppression
statement: v1alpha1 ModelDeployment/ModelCache/GPUGroup types require ~2,700 LOC in api/v1alpha1/, 865 LOC in model_deployment.go, 271 cross-package references, 3 nolint:staticcheck suppressions in CLI commands, and a disabled SA1019 lint rule in .golangci.yml. Migration guide exists at docs/migration/v1alpha1-to-v1alpha2.md.
evidence: grep -c v1alpha1 across non-api Go files = 271 references. CLI commands list.go, delete.go, status.go, benchmark.go, cache.go, quantize.go all import v1alpha1. golangci.yml disables SA1019 globally to suppress deprecation warnings. 3 nolint:staticcheck directives in CLI. quantization_convert.go bridges v1alpha2→v1alpha1 for patching.
notes: v1alpha2 is the primary API. v1alpha1 kept for backward compat with existing deployments. Removal requires: (1) migrate all deployed CRs, (2) update CLI to v1alpha2, (3) remove v1alpha1 types, (4) re-enable SA1019 lint. Consider a phased approach: first update CLI commands to v1alpha2, then remove v1alpha1 types after a deprecation period.

title: 47 Dockerfiles and 47 CI jobs create massive build maintenance surface
statement: 47 Dockerfiles in build/ with significant duplication across GPU architectures (gfx1100, gfx906, maxwell, cuda) and backends (vllm, diffusers, llamacpp, mlc, comfyui). CI pipeline is 1,638 LOC with 47 jobs. Many Dockerfiles share identical patterns (ROCm base setup, Python dep installation, HF cache config) but are maintained independently.
evidence: ls build/Dockerfile.* | wc -l = 47. wc -l .gitlab-ci.yml = 1638. 8 MLC-LLM Dockerfiles alone. 6 vLLM variants. 4 diffusers variants. 3 quantizer-gptq variants. Each GPU arch variant duplicates ROCm setup boilerplate. CI jobs for backends changed <1 time in last 60 days are still built on every pipeline.
notes: Options: (A) Multi-stage Dockerfile templates with build args for arch/backend selection — reduces 47 files to ~10-15. (B) Use CI rules: to skip unchanged backend image builds (already partially done with changes: rules). (C) Consolidate MLC-LLM variants first (8 files, least used). (D) Consider dropping MLC-LLM entirely if vLLM/llamacpp cover all use cases.

title: Proxy model resolver and K8s activator have no unit tests
statement: model_resolver.go (255 LOC) handles model name → backend routing resolution. k8s_activator.go (195 LOC) handles scale-from-zero activation. Neither has test coverage. These are on the critical path for every inference request.
evidence: model_resolver_test.go (3.6K) and k8s_activator_test.go (8.4K) now exist and provide coverage for alias resolution, TTL cache, and scale-from-zero flows.
notes: Resolved. Test files created during tech debt wave 1 work.

title: Quantization package finetune and image modules untested
statement: finetune.go (377 LOC) builds fine-tuning job specs. image.go (157 LOC) resolves GPU arch-specific container images.
evidence: image_test.go (3.0K) and finetune_test.go (9.1K) now exist and cover GPU arch image resolution matrix and job spec generation.
notes: Resolved. Test files created during tech debt wave 1 work.

title: MLC-LLM backend has 8 Dockerfiles, 16 CI references, and declining usage
statement: MLC-LLM backend has 206 LOC in mlc_llm.go, 8 Dockerfiles (build, rocm64-build, rocm64-full, rocm64-gfx906, rocm64-gfx1100, cuda, cuda-maxwell, rocm64-hipblas), and 16 CI job references. vLLM and llama.cpp now cover all MLC-LLM use cases with better performance and community support.
evidence: ls build/Dockerfile.mlc-* = 8 files. grep mlc .gitlab-ci.yml = 16 references. No MLC-LLM model CRs in deploy/models/. 27 code references in Go source. MLC-LLM project itself has low activity compared to vLLM/llama.cpp.
notes: Candidate for deprecation. If no active users, remove: backend/mlc_llm.go, 8 Dockerfiles, CI jobs. Reduces build surface by ~17%. Keep backend interface for future re-addition if needed.

title: model_cache.go at 904 LOC is the largest untested controller file
statement: model_cache.go (904 LOC) now has comprehensive test coverage via model_cache_test.go (1341 LOC, 30 tests).
evidence: controllers/model_cache_test.go: 30 tests covering download job creation, cache readiness, status transitions, ensureCache edge cases, ensureQuantization, and matchingModelCache.
notes: Resolved. 30 unit tests covering all exported functions and critical edge cases.

title: interface{} → any modernization
statement: All interface{} occurrences replaced with any across Go source files.
evidence: grep -c 'interface{}' across all Go source files = 0. Completed in commit 931d8f8 (codex/debt-wave1-tests-any-20260323 branch).
notes: Resolved by prior agent session. Zero interface{} remaining in source.

title: model_deployment.go duplicates 865 LOC of deployment reconciliation logic
statement: model_deployment.go contains v1alpha1-era deployment reconciliation (ensureService, ensureDeployment, mergeContainers, etc.) that largely duplicates the v1alpha2 model_controller.go path. Functions like podSecurityContextEqual, podObjectEqual, deploymentChangedFields exist in this file but serve the same purpose as their v1alpha2 counterparts.
evidence: wc -l controllers/model_deployment.go = 865. Functions: ensureService, ensureDeployment, deploymentChangedFields, mergeContainers, podSecurityContextEqual, podObjectEqual — all have equivalents in the v1alpha2 controller path. This file is still actively maintained (27 changes in recent history).
notes: Blocked by v1alpha1 deprecation. If v1alpha1 is removed, this entire file goes with it. Alternatively, extract shared reconciliation helpers into a common package used by both v1alpha1 and v1alpha2 controllers to reduce duplication now.

title: Metrics exporter at 522 LOC has no test coverage
statement: exporter.go (522 LOC) now has comprehensive test coverage via exporter_test.go (839 LOC, 22 tests).
evidence: pkg/metrics/exporter_test.go: 22 tests covering descriptor contracts (names, help, labels, types), collection callbacks, histogram buckets, cardinality guards, and collector interface compliance.
